hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: The UI chrome is cleanly styled (modern button group, clear active state, good typographic hierarchy) but the Circle Pack view is vertically clipped — the bottom of the layout bleeds out of the container — and the edge bundle overlay creates a dense, organic tangle that overwhelms the hierarchical encoding rather than clarifying it.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Correct scaleSqrt for force-layout circle sizing and sunburst radial encoding, data-driven domains via d3.extent, and key functions on node/link joins; hierarchy-link join omits a key function but full re-render on new data avoids corruption.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Force layout starts an anonymous 750ms flubber path transition outside the main svg.transition() scheduler, so subsequent layout clicks cannot interrupt it; mouseover iterates all 300 links and mutates classes on every event with no throttle or RAF guard.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Single-view-at-a-time design limits working memory load, but the edge bundles snaking organically through the circle pack create immediate visual confusion — the dark tangled lines read as noise rather than structure, and 8 layout buttons plus 4 control groups add decision overhead without clear visual hierarchy to guide the eye.
